rules.statement: A lessee can still claim the right to compensation for improvements even if a forfeiture clause in a lease is not enforced, as long as no damage has resulted from the default and the breach was due to accident or mistake.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Court of Equity in England was from an early period accustomed to grant relief against the payment of the whole penalty on money bonds; and the Statutes 4 and 5 Ann. c. 16, ss. 12 and 13, and 8 and 9 Will. III. c. 11 conferred a similar jurisdiction on the Courts of Law."
